sloka: विदीर्यमाणा हर्षेण धात्री तु परया मुदा ।आच्च्क्षे/अथ कुब्जायै भूयसीं राघवश्रियम् ॥२-७-१०॥
transliteration: vidīryamāṇā harṣeṇa dhātrī tu parayā mudā ।ācckṣe/atha kubjāyai bhūyasīṁ rāghavaśriyam ॥2-7-10॥

translations.english: Bursting with great joy, the royal maid related to the hunchback the great fortune awaiting the son of the Raghus (Rama).
